posts.content:
So. Big news. The kind that people write “We are delighted to announce…” posts about.

For years, we’ve told clients that the thing that makes you famous is often the thing that holds you back.

Now, as a brand that absolutely crushed it on [checks notes] *Slideshare* during the content marketing goldrush, we’re finally taking our own advice.

Because the shape of B2B marketing is changing fast. Attention is scarcer. Performance is flatlining. AI is rewriting all the rules, everywhere. 
It all points to a big question: WTF is a marketing agency partner *for* in 2025?

So here’s our answer.

We’re joining forces with some of our friends in Next 15 (and frankly some of the most talented and clever minds in B2B) to create something new. 

Pretzl.com is a full-service marketing company built to decode the messiness of how complex B2B buying actually happens.

It's a blend of creativity, data and AI that helps brands understand the real journeys their customers take, and show up in more valuable and impactful ways. 

We’re taking everything that made Velocity special with us (creative mojo, strategic clarity, performance obsession) and developing some tech that helps marketers deliver more value to customers and more pipeline to the business.

It's the same Velocity in a glorious new shape.

We're stoked. We hope you will be too.

posts.content:
It’s been over a year in the making, but today is finally here: Agent3 x Pretzl, Twogether, Publitek, This Machine and Velocity Partners are now officially one big Pretzl. 

We started a new company together because there’s a new shape to B2B buying — with twists, folds and loops (and often a little salt).

It’s a toothy problem to solve — the kind we’ve always loved — and it’s a privilege to get to crack it with so many talented new friends.

Of course, it’s also been a privilege to be a part of Velocity — and whether you’ve worked with us, or for us, or just cheered us on from the sidelines, we want to say from the bottom of our big stupid hearts: thank you for making this place so special.  

If you’ve worked with us before, you’re still in excellent hands — just now with a few hundred more brilliant colleagues backing you up. 

And if you’re a B2B marketer, we’d love you to join us as we start the next chapter.

If that’s you, head over to the Pretzl page, or head straight to Pretzl.com to explore more.
